objective: The generic result seam's closed Rust population is release-accountable through a fail-empty wrapper.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:generic-work-result-seam pins the work_result daemon population (20 on unix; the earlier count of 16 was stale) by exact name, then runs the all-feature ioi-types contract suite with a non-empty floor.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: npm run mutate:generic-work-result-seam plants (a) an absent test name, refused by the source binding; (b) a name whose fn exists but whose module path the harness cannot list, refused at --list; (c) an empty population, refused outright — the wrapper proves it can fail on its own finding before it is trusted green.
remaining_nonclaims: The wrapper proves the pinned tests execute and pass; it does not widen what those tests assert. The unit's acceptance clauses are proven only to the extent the pinned tests prove them.
A CI floor is not yet pinned for these root-workspace wrappers; verifier-floors.v1.json covers hypervisor-app journey verifiers only.
